turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: Lifting is a great stress reliever. Are you and Grace planning a quiet night in after that workout?

turns.text: That's exactly the plan. We ordered some food and we're going to put on a nature documentary in a bit. Just want to zone out and watch some wildlife.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A nature documentary sounds incredibly relaxing. Do you think you'll get some time in your woodworking shop this weekend, too?

turns.text: I'd love to, but I think I'll hold off until next week. Once school is fully out, I'll have all the time in the world for my woodworking projects.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Fair enough! It's good to have that to look forward to. I hope you and Grace enjoy your evening.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I appreciate it. Talk to you later.
